fresh_prepaid_run_accounting.scope: Cents for display only; charges, unknowns, reservations and allocations remain separate. No refund inferred.

scope_notes: Every provider retains the frozen 37-question/155-criterion denominator. Partial coverage is not a complete leaderboard.
Raw semantic correctness and retention/recovery credit are separate. Native extraction mistakes remain outcomes.
All selected primary source inputs and native context traces are independently audited; per-provider audit state is explicit.
Selected provider costs include retries and recovery in that component; extra attempts remain separate. Each ledger attempt is counted once.
Settled cost is actual OpenRouter response usage.cost. Missing usage and unknown charge bounds are not zero. Exact private receipts are retained.
The prepaid continuation budget has a later activation boundary than the original scored cohort. Its fresh charges and earlier selected scored charges must not be conflated.
Source authoring and earlier import qualification are excluded from selected scored provider costs. Shared fixture authoring cost was 0.160965661696 USD; local compute is unpriced.
Phase times include native processing, API calls, harness overhead, startup prelude, failures, and recovery where observed. They are concurrent functional trials, not clean latency rankings.
Supermemory accepted-source recovery needed no reupload/refresh; its ingest interval includes the stopped/recovery gap.

Honcho timeout recovery uses recorded enrolled queue rows and successful native cleanup inside error retention. Original timeout receipt and returncode1 remain; retention was reconstructed from unchanged inherited settings and revalidated on native reopen.
Per-call observed durations, token counts, reasoning counts, statuses and unique IDs are retained in details; absent telemetry is explicitly missing.
Identical request fingerprints are not proof of retry loops. Explicit replay relationships are distinct from authorized retry grants.
